blocks.content: Disassemble the power end ( STi and MTi with duplex bearings)

blocks.section: Disassemble the power end ( STi and MTi with duplex bearings)
blocks.content: Remove the clamp screws (370C) and back off the jam nuts (423).

blocks.section: Disassemble the power end ( STi and MTi with duplex bearings)
blocks.content: Tighten the jack screws (370D) evenly to move the bearing housing (134) out of  the bearing frame (228A).

blocks.section: Disassemble the power end ( STi and MTi with duplex bearings)
blocks.content: Remove the shaft assembly from the bearing frame (228A).

blocks.section: Disassemble the power end ( STi and MTi with duplex bearings)
blocks.content: Remove the jack screws (370D) with the nuts (423).

blocks.section: Disassemble the power end ( STi and MTi with duplex bearings)
Disassemble the power end ( STi and MTi with duplex bearings)
blocks.content: Remove the clamp ring screws (236A) and separate the clamp ring (253B) from the bearing housing (134).

blocks.section: Disassemble the power end ( STi and MTi with duplex bearings)
blocks.content: You must remove the bearings before you can remove the clamp ring from the shaft.

blocks.section: Disassemble the power end ( STi and MTi with duplex bearings)
blocks.content: Remove the bearing housing (134) and the bearings (112A and 168A) from the shaft (122).
